# echo

> Rate limits and caching for serverless APIs: correct, tested, costed limiters and caches, as a CLI, an MCP server and skills.

echo is an agent-native, self-improving employee: a senior distributed-systems engineer that turns "use Upstash"
into a correct, tested, costed limiter or cache. It externalizes the cross-request state that turbo forbids in
`app/api/**`, refuses a `new Map()` counter, a spoofable-header key and a limiter on Cloudflare KV, and proves the
limit actually holds under concurrent load. Coding agents operate it through the CLI and the MCP server; people
watch it in a local cockpit. Reachability is N/A. Powered by Energy. Read [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) first.

The three roots every failure in this vertical reduces to: (1) shared-mutable-state, a Map, a header, a non-atomic
counter or a per-instance dedup trusted when it shouldn't be; fix with an atomic, shared counter in an external store
and keys built in one place. (2) Synchronization, cache-expiry stampedes and retry storms; fix with jitter (TTLs and
full-jitter backoff) and distributed coordination (single-flight, not in-process). (3) Keys as broken contracts,
spoofable headers and coverage or prefix drift; fix by building the key in one function and making coverage a test.

Default stack: on edge or serverless, `@upstash/ratelimit` (sliding window for HTTP throttling, token bucket for
bursts) on Upstash Redis over HTTP, with `ephemeralCache` on, `waitUntil(pending)` when analytics or multi-region is
on, `timeout` tuned per fail-open or fail-closed, and Regional, not Global, for write-heavy limiters. Long-running
Node: `rate-limiter-flexible` on ioredis to Redis or Valkey over TCP. Exact global limits at the edge: a Cloudflare
Durable Object. Cloudflare KV is a read cache, never a counter. Caching: stale-while-revalidate, always a TTL with
jitter, version-keyed LLM responses, centralized invalidation. Idempotency: the Stripe pattern, fail-closed, with a
database unique constraint as the backstop. The default is wired; alternatives are documented, not wired.

Run it: `npx -y -p github:naman10parikh/echo echo-cli --help` (the CLI; use `echo-cli`, because a shell's built-in
`echo` shadows a bin named `echo`) and `npx -y -p github:naman10parikh/echo echo-mcp` (the MCP server over stdio).
Commands: `audit <path>` (a source-of-truth Map is a bug, exit 1; the `ephemeralCache` Map is fine), `limiter
<endpoint-kind>`, `cache <pattern>`, `idempotency <endpoint>`, `stampede <key-cost>`, `cost --algo <a> --rps <n>
[--regions <n>] [--analytics]`, `key <entity> <id>`, `store --runtime <edge|node|cf>`, `brain "<question>"` (BM25
over `brain/`), `doctor` (asserts `UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL` and `_TOKEN`), `example --runtime <r>` and `design
<endpoint>` (routes a request to the right sub-tools and chains them). The acceptance bar: the limiter admits
exactly the limit under a concurrent burst, the cache serves stale while it refetches, and `audit` exits non-zero
on a `new Map()` counter; it runs locally at no cost with no credentials.

- [SANDBOX.md](SANDBOX.md): the Redis plus serverless-redis-http acceptance envelope (no cost, no credentials) and the on-demand live-Upstash job.

## MCP tools

- [src/mcp-server.ts](src/mcp-server.ts): echo's own server over stdio, 10 tools that reuse the CLI's pure functions so they never drift: `echo_audit_state`, `echo_design_limiter`, `echo_design_cache`, `echo_design_idempotency`, `echo_design_stampede`, `echo_cost`, `echo_key`, `echo_recommend_store`, `echo_ask` and `echo_doctor`.
- [.mcp.json](.mcp.json): the stranger-safe config: echo's server from GitHub and context7, no secrets.

## Skills

- [skills/echo-state-audit/SKILL.md](skills/echo-state-audit/SKILL.md): the flagship: the `new Map()`-on-serverless judgment, a source-of-truth Map is a bug, the `ephemeralCache` Map is fine (O-01, O-02, P-01 to P-03, S-01).
- [skills/echo-limiter-design/SKILL.md](skills/echo-limiter-design/SKILL.md): identity key, an atomic shared decision, a concurrency cap, fail-open or fail-closed, IPv6 /64, a spend cap; refuses spoofable-header keys (O-03 to O-09).
- [skills/echo-invalidation/SKILL.md](skills/echo-invalidation/SKILL.md): always a TTL with jitter, delete rather than update, database first, invalidate in `finally`, version-keyed LLM caches; knows `revalidateTag` is lazy (O-10 to O-14).
- [skills/echo-stampede-herd/SKILL.md](skills/echo-stampede-herd/SKILL.md): distributed single-flight, full-jitter backoff, admission first, fix the origin before caching (O-15 to O-18).
- [skills/echo-cost-and-migrate/SKILL.md](skills/echo-cost-and-migrate/SKILL.md): count commands not requests, Regional not Global, the fixed-instance break-even, never a limiter on Cloudflare KV, Valkey as the cost default (O-19, O-20, O-23).

## Sub-agents and hook

- [.claude/agents/echo-limiter-reviewer.md](.claude/agents/echo-limiter-reviewer.md): reviews a diff against the P-01 to P-29 limiter pitfalls.
- [.claude/agents/echo-invalidation-auditor.md](.claude/agents/echo-invalidation-auditor.md): cache staleness: `DEL→0` unlogged, no TTL, a forgotten write path, the dual-write race.
- [hooks/echo-state-guard.js](hooks/echo-state-guard.js): a PreToolUse hook that blocks a `new Map()` source-of-truth counter in `app/api/**` and passes the `ephemeralCache` Map, using the same detector as `echo audit`.
